description:
Fleet action-conditioned signal effectiveness (free read).

Filters: source_type (e.g. youtube/rss/api/on_chain), signal_type,
window (24h|7d|30d|90d|all). Returns, per matching signal_effectiveness
collective insight, the fleet action taken, effect_size, confidence
interval, contributing-agent count n, crowding_index,
and staleness. Historical collective performance data aggregated across
the fleet -- descriptive only, never a recommendation or a promise of
results.

Workflow: INTELLIGENCE step -- weigh a signal by how the FLEET's
actions on it have historically resolved, alongside your own
get_source_accuracy / get_my_performance track record.
name: get_signal_effectiveness
